# List of vice presidents of the Philippines by age__disambig_1

This is a list of vice presidents of the Philippines by age.
Overview
The 1987 Constitution provides that the vice president shall have the same qualifications as the president, who must be at least least forty years of age on the day of the election. The median age upon the accession to the vice presidency is 55 years, the approximate age when Elpidio Quirino, Joseph Estrada, and Noli de Castro assumed office. The youngest person to become the vice president of the Philippines is Sara Duterte, at age . The oldest vice president to assume office is Teofisto Guingona Jr., at age . He is both the oldest when he left office and the oldest living former vice president.
The youngest living former vice president is Leni Robredo, at age . Elpidio Quirino had the shortest post-vice presidency timespan, dying  after he left office. Emmanuel Pelaez lived the longest of any vice president after their tenure, dying  after leaving office.
